names.note: Her own name, read out of doxologia.ro's line for 4 iunie, «Sfintele Mironosițe Maria și Marta, surorile Dreptului Lazăr», which names two women.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Ιουνίου, «Αγίες Μάρθα και Μαρία οι αδελφές του Λαζάρου», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 4. јун ст. ст., „Свете Марта и Марија“, which names the two sisters and nothing else. Свете is not a rank, so there is nothing to strip and the bare personal name is the whole of the form. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so this is the first holder.

The name as days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2606 gives it, «Марфа Вифанская», with nothing, the page giving no rank word at all taken off. Measured with the gate's own fold before it was written: 'вифанская марфа' has no other holder. The day line prints only «Марфы» in the genitive, so Bethany is read off the name page; the folder's Serbian form is the bare «Марта» and folds apart from this one.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 4 июня ст. ст. — «Свв. Марфы и Марии , сестер прав. Лазаря (I).»

attestations.note: The day's third entry of eleven, «Свв. Марфы и Марии , сестер прав. Лазаря (I).», one line naming the two sisters and naming their brother only to say whose sisters they are. **Лазарь TOOK NOTHING from this day**: a third `name:` link stands under the line, «Святитель Лазарь Четверодневный, Китийский, епископ» with its own life page, but «Свв.» and the genitive govern only the two women and he is not commemorated here. The Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows of both folders already stand on this same 4 June. `life1229`, which both name links point at, was NOT read; the identification is the day, the names, the Bethany of both name pages and the sisterhood the line itself states, and the folders' lives already carry the Gospel account from the other three calendars. The day page prints ONE hymn for the two of them together, a troparion in глас 3 headed «Тропарь праведных Марфы и Марии», and it is added to both folders. That heading is also the only grading the source gives them — праведных, the righteous — where the day line says only «Свв.», the saints, and `righteous` is accordingly the first entry either folder's empty `types` has ever had. **`dates` were written for the first time from «(I)»**, the line's own century, both folders having held none; neither has `locations`, so `map-span.test.mjs` is not in question. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 4 iunie — «Sfintele Mironosițe Maria și Marta, surorile Dreptului Lazăr»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Ιουνίου — «Αγίες Μάρθα και Μαρία οι αδελφές του Λαζάρου»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day as the folder's Romanian row, and it carries both sisters on one page with a head line each. They are plainly the same two: the sisters of Lazarus at Bethany. Two hymns are taken and both stand in both folders, because both name both sisters. The page prints three further texts — a μεγαλυνάριον, an οἶκος and a κάθισμα — which are not taken, because the schema holds a troparion and a kontakion and nothing else; the κάθισμα is the one that distinguishes the sisters, saying that the one prepared food for him in faith while the other anointed him with myrrh and wiped the Lord's feet with the hair of her head. The page gives no year for either of them and no place but Bethany, so no `dates` object is added and `locations` is left out.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 17.06.2026 (4. јун ст. ст.) — „Свете Марта и Марија“

attestations.note: The day’s sixth and last entry, which names her first of two. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, without a closing full stop, as every heading of this wave is. THE SHORTEST ENTRY OF THE DAY AND IT CORROBORATES THE ONE THING THAT MATTERS ON THIS FOLDER. Four sentences: sisters of Lazarus; after the Lord’s ascension Lazarus went to preach the Gospel; in this his sisters helped him; „Не зна се где су скончале“ — it is not known where they ended. **That last sentence is why `dates` and `locations` are both absent here, and a third book stating it outright is worth more to this folder than a new scene would be**: doxologia says the same in its three sentences, and saint.gr says only that the sisters were counted worthy to die peacefully and not under persecution. No year, no place, from any of the three. `dates` AND `locations` DELIBERATELY STILL ABSENT, AND THE LIFE CARRIES NO DIGITS so that no sentence of it can put a year beside an end this corpus does not record. `types` STILL EMPTY, AND THAT IS A READING TOO. Свете is not a rank and this heading has no other word in it. doxologia’s day line calls the two «Sfintele Mironosițe» and saint.gr’s kathisma calls them deacons of Christ; **myrrh-bearer is not in the `types` vocabulary at all**, `deaconess` would be written on a hymn and not on a life, and this book gives neither word. So the folder keeps no type, as it has since it was made. `related` UNTOUCHED: the sister and the brother are both already there, and this entry names no one else. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so this is the first holder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Τῷ Σωτῆρι ἀμέμπτως διακονήσασαι, αἱ τοῦ Ἁγίου Λαζάρου θεῖαι αὐτάδελφοι, σὺν τῇ Μάρθᾳ τῇ κλεινῇ, Μαρία πάνσεμνε, καὶ τὴν Ἀνάστασιν Αὐτοῦ, σὺν Μυροφόροις Γυναιξί, μαθοῦσαι ἐκ τοῦ Ἀγγέλου, φωτὸς ἐμπλήσθητε θείου, ἡμῖν αἰτοῦσαι τὰ σωτήρια.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος πλ. α´, Τὸν Συνάναρχον Λόγον, on the page of the two sisters; it names them both, which is why it stands in both folders

english.text: Having served the Saviour blamelessly, O divine sisters of holy Lazarus — renowned Martha and all-revered Mary — and having learned of his Resurrection from the angel together with the myrrh-bearing women, you were filled with divine light. Ask for us the things that bring salvation.

hymns.text: Τῶν ἀδελφῶν τὴν δυάδα τὴν πάντιμον, τὰς τοῦ Λαζάρου συγγόνους τιμήσωμεν, Μαρίαν καὶ Μάρθαν ἐν ᾄσμασιν, ὡς ἂν αὐτῶν ἱκεσίαις πρὸς Κύριον, πταισμάτων συγχώρησιν λάβωμεν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος β´, Τοῖς τῶν αἱμάτων σου, on the page of the two sisters; it names them both

english.text: Let us honour in song the all-honoured pair of sisters, the kinswomen of Lazarus, Mary and Martha, that by their entreaties to the Lord we may receive forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Праведнаго Лазаря Боголюбивыя сестры,/ Марфо и Марие преславныя,/ чистым сердцем Христа в житии вашем возлюбили есте,/ мироносиц вземше чин,/ и Его, яко Сына Божия, безбоязненно исповедали есте,/ сего ради ныне во обителех Отца Небеснаго/ со Ангелы и всеми святыми славно царствуете./ Умолите, Егоже возлюбили есте,/ и нам, грешным, в вере и любви Христовой утвердитися/ и Царствия Небеснаго сподобитися.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, «Тропарь праведных Марфы и Марии», глас 3, under «Молитвы» on the day page for 4 июня ст. ст.. It is printed once, for the two of them together, and names both in the vocative, so it stands on both folders. It also names their brother; a hymn naming another saint owes no `related` row, `related-floor.mjs` reading `life.md` prose only.

english.text: God-loving sisters of the righteous Lazarus, O most glorious Martha and Mary, with a pure heart ye loved Christ in your life, taking up the order of the myrrh-bearers, and fearlessly confessed Him to be the Son of God; and therefore ye now reign in glory in the mansions of the heavenly Father with the angels and all the saints. Entreat Him whom ye loved, that we sinners also be established in the faith and the love of Christ and be counted worthy of the Kingdom of heaven.

death.note: The day line closes with the bare century, «(I)», and that is the only date this calendar gives them. The folder held no `dates` at all before this; nothing narrower was inferred, and the Gospel gives no year.
